steps.title: How the partnership works
steps.subtitle: Three things happen, in this order. Nothing else is asked of you.

open.title: Open your partner account
open.body: Tell us about your shop. Approved partners get two free events, then pay per event or by the pack.

build.title: Build the invitation
build.body: You set it up on your customer's behalf — photos, agenda, guest list. They appear as the host; you stay the owner.

sell.title: Activate, and get paid
sell.body: Spend one credit and the invitation goes live immediately. What your customer pays you is yours.

pricing.title: The more you take, the more you make
pricing.subtitle: A Basic invitation retails at $60–85. Your first two events cost you nothing; after that, pay per event with nothing up front, or buy a pack and pay less for every one.

trial.name: Free trial
trial.note: Set up two real invitations for real customers before you pay us anything. Whatever you charge for them is yours.

payg.name: Pay as you go
payg.note: Half the package price, every time. The way to start while your volume is still uncertain.

pricing.footnote: Basic package rates. The Standard package retails at $120–150 per event and has wholesale rates of its own — ask when we open your account. Profit assumes you sell every invitation in the pack; what you charge your own customer is your decision. Prices in USD.

product.title: An invitation your customer could not make themselves
product.subtitle: This is what lands on their guests' phones.
product.previewHint: Pick a design and read the whole invitation it produces.

cover.label: The opening
cover.body: One link, in the chat they already use.

rsvp.label: The reply
rsvp.body: Countdown, RSVP and gift details — nothing to install.

wishes.label: The wishes

templates.subtitle: Pick a design and the real invitation opens with it — English and Khmer.
templates.viewAll: Show all screens side by side
templates.note: A real invitation, shown as a sample. Every word, picture, colour and language is set per event — and the logo at the foot of the invitation is your shop’s, beside ours.

empty.title: The design catalogue is not loading
empty.body: It is there — this page just could not reach it. Message us and we will walk you through the designs directly.

partner.title: Built for shops, not for resellers of a link

branding.title: Your logo on every invitation
branding.body: Your logo sits beside ours at the foot of every invitation you produce.

listing.title: Your shop in our services directory
listing.body: List your shop on GoEvent's services page, where people planning an event already look.

ownership.title: You own the event
ownership.body: Your customer needs no account and no password.

instant.title: Activation is instant
instant.body: A credit activates the template on the spot — no proof to upload, no waiting.

locked.title: Your credits cannot be stolen
locked.body: A credit code only works from your own account. A leak costs you nothing.

studio.title: Publish your own templates
studio.body: Approved partners design and publish their own templates in the studio.

topup.title: Top up whenever you like
topup.body: Balance, batches and orders on one page in your account.

unsold.q: What happens if I do not sell them all?
unsold.a: Credits sit in your account until you spend them. Each batch carries its own validity, shown on your credits page. If your volume is uncertain, use your two free events, stay on pay as you go, and move to a pack once the work is steady.

price.q: Can I set my own price?
price.a: Yes. Wholesale is what you pay us. What you charge your customer is entirely your decision, and we take no share of it.

domain.q: Is the invitation under my own brand?
domain.a: Your shop's logo appears beside ours at the foot of every invitation. The invitation itself is hosted on goevent.online, which is what keeps it fast and nothing for you to maintain. There is no custom domain.

plans.q: Do credits work on any template?
plans.a: Credits are scoped to the plan you bought them for. A Basic credit activates any Basic template, on any event category — but not a Standard one. This page shows Basic rates.

payment.q: How do I pay for a pack?
payment.a: Bank transfer or QR. Place the order, upload your proof of payment, and we issue the credits once it is confirmed — usually the same working day.

customer.q: Does my customer need an account?
customer.a: No. You create and own the event; they appear on it as the host. Their guests only ever open a link — no app, no sign-up, nothing to install.

apply.q: How do I become a partner?
apply.a: Send a request with your shop's name, a number we can reach you on, and roughly how many events you take on each month. We read every request by hand and normally come back within two working days.

closing.title: Your first two invitations are on us
closing.subtitle: Tell us about your shop. If it is a fit we will open your account, and you can set up two real invitations before you pay us anything.
